paragraphs.text: ABSTRACT We describe a parser that recovers sections, paragraphs, tables and equations from two-column articles while keeping every element traceable to a page and a block identifier.
paragraphs.first_sentence: ABSTRACT We describe a parser that recovers sections, paragraphs, tables and equations from two-column articles while keeping every element traceable to a page and a block identifier.

paragraphs.text: Two-column layouts interleave reading order with geometry. A parser that ignores columns concatenates lines from different paragraphs and silently corrupts the meaning of the text.
paragraphs.first_sentence: Two-column layouts interleave reading order with geometry.

paragraphs.text: The central difficulty is that a column break is invisible in the raw content stream: the next text run simply jumps back to the left margin, several hundred points higher on the page. Any consumer of the extracted text inherits that jump as a broken sentence.
paragraphs.first_sentence: The central difficulty is that a column break is invisible in the raw content stream: the next text run simply jumps back to the left margin, several hundred points higher on the page.

paragraphs.text: The continuation rule we adopt is simple but effective: a paragraph that does not terminate with sentence punctuation and is immediately followed, at the head of the next column, by text that begins in lower case is treated as one paragraph that was split by the column break, and the two fragments are rejoined in reading order before any downstream analysis runs on the text.

paragraphs.text: We group words into lines by vertical overlap, then sweep a vertical corridor across the page to locate the gutter. Lines that cross the corridor are treated as full-width elements and interrupt the column stream rather than joining either column.
paragraphs.first_sentence: We group words into lines by vertical overlap, then sweep a vertical corridor across the page to locate the gutter.

paragraphs.text: The affinity of the binding site is given by where each term is the total energy in kcal per mole.

paragraphs.text: The parsed order matched the visual order on all pages of the reference set. Table 1 was recovered with four rows and four columns, including its header row.

paragraphs.text: Residuals stay below the reporting precision of the source tables. The relative deviation is written as and never exceeds four percent in the reference set.
paragraphs.first_sentence: Residuals stay below the reporting precision of the source tables.

paragraphs.text: Column-aware ordering plus explicit continuation merging recovers paragraphs that a naive reader splits across the column break. Every emitted element carries a page and block identifier, so any downstream claim can be traced back to the exact source region.
paragraphs.first_sentence: Column-aware ordering plus explicit continuation merging recovers paragraphs that a naive reader splits across the column break.
